## What changed

User-visible claim, owning context, and smallest affected boundary. Name any
public surface added or widened.

## Why

Problem and constraints.

## Invariants

What must still hold after this change, and how it is held. When one slice
crosses several owners, say why it is one change rather than several.

## Validation

Status, then exact commands and proportionate manual or contextual proof. When
a choice is context-dependent, name the evidence that would reopen it.
Otherwise use `Not run` with reason.

## Risks

Behavior, ownership, lifecycle, protocol, privacy, deployment, demo, and
documentation risks.

## Deferred

Intentionally untouched work, and the one next step.
